name: B10-0188/2025 (S&D) – Severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the violence in Sudan between the two rival armed forces, including rape and sexual violence against children. It calls on both sides to stop fighting, protect civilians and let aid reach everyone. It asks the European Union to give more money for humanitarian aid and survivors of sexual violence, and to sanction commanders responsible for human rights abuses. It also wants the United Nations arms embargo on Darfur extended to all of Sudan.

- The Parliament asks for more EU aid and sanctions on abusers; it does not itself change any law.
- People affected: civilians in Sudan, especially children and survivors of sexual violence.
- Next: EU countries and the EU Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
